delivery.outcome: Carry the retry loop's mutable run state in a dedicated object with named policy steps so apply_patch_with_retry clears the god-function thresholds (fan-out, mutations) while preserving identical patch transaction, retry, drift-abort and evidence generation semantics.
nonGoals: Changing patch transaction execution or verification flow
Altering evidence bundle schema or fields
Touching other flagged functions in the module (_finish_run has its own signal)

architecture.decision: Introduce a small mutable run-state carrier (budget, remaining, manifest, attempts, authorize) with named steps for attempt recording and per-iteration advance; apply_patch_with_retry becomes the thin loop over them.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the previous inline retry loop.

validation.evidence: Scope authorization recorded from the planfile PLF-030 handoff.
